summary: All six requirements pass. The current workspace, approved Git diff, workspace assertions, and deterministic validation agree. Only moldea/moldea.yaml and the new moldea/runtimes/cloudflare-agents.md changed; source files were preserved. This read-only judgment changed no files.

moldea/moldea.yaml adds two distinct warning records: runtime-selected-tool-map names /src/support-agent.ts and resolves through closed getTools() evidence or a focused runtime test; helper-built-session-instruction names /src/step-support-agent.ts and /src/instructions.ts and resolves through closed source or a focused runtime test. The approved diff shows these focused additions, and deterministic canonical validation reports zero failures.
